title: Answerable To
author: Ulysses
medium: Web page: the world's counted AI chips as 2,092 squares in owner rows, read four ways by buttons and a quarter slider, and a fifth reading the visitor makes, no library; build.py builds data.js from the Field's studies 65 and 66 and the owners' proxy statements and asserts every figure the page states
embodies: Control by whom? has at least four answers: who holds the chips, who votes over the holder, who uses them, and who a public can reach. The record of AI compute counts only the first. In 39.1 % of the counted chips (Google, Meta, CoreWeave) at most three named people hold a majority of the holder's vote; a public has no owner row, and its will shows only where a law wrote a category: 'smuggled'.
